rows.grounds: conjunction adding to the preceding list
fused form: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) + mūlakaulam (root Kaula); internal sandhi noted, token kept whole

items.question: What doctrinal status does the attainment of the eight powers hold within the root Kaula teaching?
premises: The eight powers are named as a specific attainment.
This attainment is identified with the root Kaula.
The identification is addressed directly to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight powers constitutes the essence of the root Kaula doctrine.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight powers is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
